question: On the actual SAME original 1-degree GPS cell, calendar month and calendar DATE with both mule deer and bighorn accepted GPS observations, is the within-cell-month Tmax association of NIGHT/DAY GPS step speed different between species, after daily astronomical daylength and antecedent P-ET0 adjustment?
source_one_degree_grid_key: floor original accepted GPS latitude, longitude, using source same cell year/month; NEVER publish lat/lon or original dates.
original_q_observation: Original GPS one fix per UTC hour, valid 0.5 to 2h physical step <=60km/h, same solar date+DAY/NIGHT part throughout, >=3 accepted DAY and NIGHT steps per original tag solar date, >=10 qualified q days per original tagged year; original q and original source/daylight n/mean must numerically replay before new shared-date analysis.
source_weather: Original first six-native 2026-11-17 ERA5 provider physical array SHA on all 28 original GPS cells and days must match exactly, including 30 day antecedent weather; any cell's missing or changed weather is SOURCE_HOLD. Do not compare or substitute earlier October ERA5 snapshots.
source_candidate_grid_yearmonth_filter: Keep all original mule-bighorn grid×year×month with >=3 distinct ORIGINAL q-qualified animal tags EACH taxon (fixed 95 initial candidates). For each, retain only calendar dates with >=1 original accepted tag DAY+NIGHT q observation from BOTH species on that EXACT date in same original grid. Same date and same cell share the exact Tmax and water predictor; astronomical daylength computed at source cell center and same date for both. Select on source observation opportunity, never on animal speed or coefficient direction.
temperature_controls: astronomical daylength at original one_degree_cell_center and calendar date
estimator: For each spatial 1° cell and each qualifying original month, on exactly matched calendar dates, form q,DAY,NIGHT per species as equal mean across original tags observed on that date. Difference=MULE−BIGHORN for q,DAY,NIGHT at that same source cell/calendar date. Within each 1°cell×year×month demean all values (q/day/night differences, Tmax, astronomical L, antecedent water). Within 1° cell pool admitted month-block date means; use FWL Tmax slope conditional L+water on those demeaned common observation days, residual SD Tmax>=0.25C, full 2covariate determinant ratio >=.01. Equal cell-level slope mean, then bootstrap 2000 whole original 1° geographic CELL clusters (not dates/individuals) to nominal percentile CI. Require q-temperature slope = NIGHT temperature slope minus DAY slope within each cell, source mean and all cluster bootstrap draws.
same_opportunity_caveat: Same original GPS cell+date gives the same modeled day weather, but animals are NOT individually paired across species; changing tagged-animal composition across dates and GPS device schedules may still affect source means. No causal or controlled heat species effect. Geographic cell clusters may not be spatially independent, so CI is exploratory.
source_fail_policy: If <5 eligible spatial cells, failed q source replay, insufficient cross-species shared dates, weather physical SHA drift, or any original registered source native missing, report truthful SOURCE_HOLD or OBSERVATION_OPPORTUNITY_UNAVAILABLE with counts and null slope, never replace original source/cells/thresholds.
public_result_allowed: Only source DOI and taxon labels, counts of candidate and eligible gridmonth/day/cell blocks, cell equal mean slopes and 95 whole-cell bootstrap CI if supported, number of positive/negative whole-cells; NEVER disclose exact GPS coords, original individual tags, dates, climate cell index or individual/day effects.
Wyoming_no_paired_gridmonth_source: Wyoming original DOI 10.5441/001/1.703 has 0 common 1° GPS cell×year×month for mule deer/bighorn; explicit no-contact source GEO_HOLD, do not substitute.
